cfs_cap: https://www.cfs.sa.gov.au SA Emergency Services Fire Incident Information 2026-11-22T18:28:31+10:30 F2611220094-2026-11-22T17:08:58+10:30-20261122182404 GRASS FIRE : LIPSON 2026-11-22T18:25:17+10:30 F2611220094-2026-11-22T17:08:58+10:30-20261122182404 emergency.services@eso.sa.gov.au 2026-11-22T18:25:17+10:30 Actual Alert Public urn:oasis:names:tc:emergency:cap:1.2:profile:CAP-AU:1.0 F-261122-0094 Lipson, Kiandra Rd (Grass Fire) en-AU Fire Grass Fire None Unknown Unknown Observed https://govshare.gov.au/xmlui/handle/10772/6495 grassFire 2026-11-22T18:25:17+10:30 2026-11-23T06:10:00+10:30 South Australian Country Fire Service LIPSON : Incident Update The SA Country Fire Service (CFS) is responding to a grass fire near Lipson on the Lower Eyre Peninsula in South Australia. Approximately 5 trucks with 25 firefighters, supported by 5 aircraft, including fire bombing planes and an observation aircraft, and 4 farm fire units are working to control the fire. SA Police are also assisting. The fire spread rapidly, burning approximately 124 hectares of grass and crops. Firefighters acted quickly to protect nearby properties, saving a house and sheds. The fire is now contained. Crews will remain at the scene into the evening, monitoring the fireground and extinguishing remaining hotspots. The fire is believed to have been started by harvesting operations. Hot and windy conditions are expected to continue over the coming days, meaning fires could spread quickly. The CFS urges local communities to stay alert and ensure they know what to do if a fire starts near them. Roads around the fire are currently open, however emergency services may be working on or near roads in the area. Motorists are asked to avoid the area where possible. If you need to travel nearby, please drive carefully and follow road conditions.
